title: Enrollment Timetable for the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements
content:
Review time, open period and re-enrollment wait for an enrollment in the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements, by tier.

| Tier | Enrollment review (business days) | Unsigned enrollment stays open (calendar days) | First term's fee paid before activation | Re-enrollment wait after expiry or cancellation (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ready Profile Service Agreement | 1 | 30 | No | 0 |
| Silver Priority Service Agreement | 2 | 30 | Yes | 0 |
| Gold Priority Service Agreement | 2 | 30 | Yes | 30 |
| Platinum Priority Service Agreement | 3 | 30 | Yes | 30 |
| Portfolio Master Service Agreement | 5 | 45 | No | 60 |
| Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement | 10 | 60 | No | 90 |

## Definitions

- **Enrollment review**: business days (Monday to Friday, excluding company holidays) to review an enrollment before it is offered for signature.
- **Unsigned enrollment stays open**: calendar days an unsigned enrollment stays open before it is withdrawn.
- **First term's fee paid before activation**: whether the first term's fee must be paid before the agreement is activated.
- **Re-enrollment wait**: calendar days after expiry or cancellation before the customer may enroll again at the same tier.

## Points read from the timetable

- The tiers that require the first term's fee to be paid before activation are the Silver Priority, Gold Priority and Platinum Priority Service Agreements.
- The Ready Profile and Silver Priority Service Agreements have a re-enrollment wait of 0 calendar days; the wait is 30 at Gold and Platinum Priority, 60 at Portfolio Master and 90 at Carrier Preferred Vendor.
- Review business days run from 1 at Ready Profile to 10 at Carrier Preferred Vendor; because they are business days, a weekend or company holiday inside the review period does not count toward it.
